mentions.name: Deterministic AI Agent Behavioral Guardrails
mentions.description: This project adds deterministic guarantees and corrective behavioral monitoring to AI agents, starting with Claude Code and ADK. It acts as security and performance bumper rails for agent behavior at zero context cost, and is open source with no signups, currently in early beta.
mentions.problem: AI agents lack deterministic guarantees around security and performance, needing corrective behavioral monitoring and guardrails.
mentions.audience: AI agent developers and teams using agent frameworks who need safety and performance guarantees
mentions.source_excerpt: Deterministic guarantees, and corrective behavioral monitoring for ai agents (starting with claude code, and ADK). Think security + performance bumper rails. At the cost of 0 context.
